1.en_consolidated_definition:
To animate 

to encourage or inspire someone or something to take action or become more lively or enthusiastic.

to enliven 

to make something more interesting or enjoyable.

to galvanize 

to give energy and enthusiasm to a person or group, often in response to a challenge or problem.

to hearten 

to give courage or confidence to someone, often by offering support or encouragement.
